_note: Hand-authored fixture (edit directly, then `pnpm --filter @oybc/shared run gen:sync-fixtures`). Pins packages/shared/src/algorithms/boardMoment.ts (tests/algorithms/boardMoment.test.ts) against its Swift twin Helpers/BoardMoment.swift (OYBCTests/BoardMomentVectorTests.swift) - docs/BOARD_MOMENTS.md. Each case is `{name, board, tasks, children?, boardTasks, allBoards?, events, expected, frames}`. Defaults for unlisted fields: Task type=normal, isCompleted=false, isDeleted=false, createdAt=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z, title=id; Event kind=increment when `delta` is set else completion, id=`e<index>`, isDeleted=false; Board status=active, timeframe=custom, totalTasks=size*size, linesCompleted=len(completedLineIds); placements isDeleted=false (a `boardTasks` entry may set `isDeleted: true` - a tombstone), boardId=board.id; links isDeleted=false. `board` = {id, size, centerSquareType, startDate, endDate, completedTasks, completedLineIds?, sealedAt?, sealedCompletedCells?, status?}; `allBoards` entries use the same shape (size 3, centre free) and feed ACHIEVEMENT cells only; `tasks[].referencedBoardId` / `achievementTrigger` configure an achievement; `isCompleted` / `completedAt` set a task's latch; `sharedCounterId` / `startDate` / `endDate` / `createdInWizard` make a linked or window-stamped derived counter. The test calls computeBoardMomentReplay(board, boardTasks, childrenByCompound, taskById, eventsByTaskId, allBoards) with events grouped by taskId (a sealed board is bounded at sealedAt inside the kernel) and compares `expected` = {order[{boardTaskId, idx, completedAt}], freeIdx, lineClosureBeat{lineId: beat}, completedTasks, totalTasks, size, finalBeat{bingo, greenlog}} (finalBeat = momentFinalBeat(replay, kind)). Instant rule: a cell's `completedAt` is `resolveContributionState(...).completedAt` ONLY when that state is complete AND names a `completingEventId`; otherwise it is null (a latched achievement, an empty all-of compound, a sealed cell with no events) and the cell sorts after every dated one, ties by idx. Beats: beat 0 = empty board; order[i] lands at beat i+1; a line closes at max(land beat of its non-FREE cells)+1; a greenlog wave reaches cell (r,c) at order.length+1+r+c; lines never flip during a greenlog's landing pass. Each `frames` entry = {kind, beat, counter, landed[idx], green[idx], popTokens{idx: token}}: counter = momentCounterAt(beat) = max(0, completedTasks - order.length + min(beat, order.length)); landed/green/popTokens come from momentCellVisual(idx, beat, replay, kind) for every idx (a cell is listed under landed/green only when true; popTokens omits null; popToken = the cell's green beat when green, else its land beat when landed, else null; the FREE centre is never `landed`). Cases: simple cells in shuffled completion order with two lines closing on the 3rd and 5th squares and a FREE centre (in its lines, never in the closure max); a counting cell whose crossing increment (08:30) is earlier than its last log (12:00); a compound whose completing child is the last of all-of; a completed ACHIEVEMENT cell (no instant) sorting after every dated cell; a 4x4 with no FREE and two lines closing at different beats; a greenlog with two squares at the same instant (tie by idx) and every line present; a sealed board whose sealedCompletedCells disagrees with live events (the sealed set wins, a post-seal event is bounded out); a FREE centre whose only placement is a tombstone is still FREE (freeIdx set, the tombstoned cell absent from order); a sealed cell whose task is missing from `tasks` is skipped (not in order) while the counter stays the rail's number; a latched achievement with a stored completedAt and an empty all-of compound both have no completing event (null, sort last); a window-stamped derived counter orders by the crossing inside its OWN window and a hub-linked counter by the crossing inside the HOST window (each case puts an earlier crossing outside the right window so it discriminates). `posterCells` is a second family: each case = {name, kind, replay (BoardMomentReplay literal: order, freeIdx, lineClosureBeat, completedTasks, totalTasks, size), cells [{idx, label, type normal|counting|compound|achievement, isFree}], expected [{...cell, state}]} and pins momentPosterCells(replay, cells, kind) (Swift free function momentPosterCells(replay:cells:kind:)): each cell's state is momentCellVisual at momentFinalBeat - green wins, else landed -> done, else undone (the FREE centre is undone unless a closed line / the greenlog wave reaches it); order and length follow `cells`.

cases.name: window-stamped-derived-counter-orders-by-its-host-window-crossing
cases.note: Context window wins (slice 0): the stamped counter (own stamp Oct 3) resolves over the HOST board window (Oct 1-7), so +2 on Oct 2 and +1 at 09:00 on Oct 3 cross its goal of 3 at 09:00 — before t0 (09:30) and t1 (10:00). It lands first.
